tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP CPQ Developer (f/m/d)
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) 2105 and 2211 for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Senior SAP CPQ Developer position at Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence. My background combines rigorous backend development in Java and Spring with complex system integrations and enterprise configuration workflows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Complex Data & API Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, and investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms with international technical teams.

bullets.label: RESTful Web Services & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows supporting storefront and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Database Optimization & Architecture
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, alongside authoring FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and custom Backoffice components.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and integration expertise adds value to Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce architecture, backend development, and enterprise integration expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence. I am eager to apply my strong foundation in Java, Spring, and complex data workflows to build robust, scalable platforms for your global operations.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP platform and integration expertise to build scalable solutions at Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building and integrating enterprise SAP Commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Senior SAP CPQ Developer role at Hexagon. My CV and cover letter are attached—I would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP CPQ Developer (f/m/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP CPQ Developer position at Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence.

With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) 2105 and 2211 for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, complex data integrations, and backend architecture.

I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I hold a valid German work permit.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
